_source: Royal Chain Limited DRHP dated 28-Sep-2026 (SEBI filing 01-Oct-2026). Rs crore = Rs million / 10. Printed page = PDF page - 4. Restated standalone financials.

basis.name: Royal Chain Limited
basis.brlm: JM Financial Limited; 360 ONE WAM Limited

1.finding: 5:1 bonus on 08-Sep-2026 is reflected: EPS 14.39 and NAV 37.16 (= Rs 4,657.51 m / 125,344,092 shares) are on the post-bonus count.

2.finding: Operating cash flow negative in all three years: -2,165.17 / -30.49 / -115.67 (Rs m, FY26/25/24) against PAT 1,733.42 / 633.31 / 273.62. Cumulative CFO/PAT = -87.5%. Inventory build of Rs 3,390.55 m in FY26 alone.

3.finding: Current tax Rs 620.00 m on PBT Rs 2,324.04 m (26.7%); cumulative current tax 26.9% of cumulative PBT. Profit is taxed in cash.

4.finding: Slump-sale purchase of the gold jewellery undertaking of promoter-interested Royal Italian Jewellery Pvt Ltd for Rs 466.20 m (FY25), plus Rs 342.50 m unsecured loan taken from it in FY26. Aalishaan Jewels LLP (KMP influence; subsidiary with 99% profit share from 01-Apr-2026) = 5.06% of FY26 sales and 4.38% of purchases.

5.finding: Fresh issue is amount-based (Rs 8,500 m), no fixed share count, so no objects price floor. Rs 6,500 m repays debt, balance GCP (cap 25% of gross) and offer expenses.

7.finding: No goodwill; other intangibles Rs 0.80 m.

8.finding: Demand side diversified: top-10 customers 22.32% of FY26 revenue (top customer is related party Aalishaan). Supply side concentrated: top-5 suppliers 56.98% and top-10 66.30% of FY26 COGS; no long-term supply agreements stated.

9.finding: Contingent liabilities Rs 200.17 m = 4.3% of net worth, of which Rs 182.63 m is a bank guarantee.

R1.finding: Auditor S. Mandanmal Mehta & Co resigned 16-Jul-2025 for lack of peer-review credentials; Jain V. & Co appointed (casual vacancy) 30-Jul-2025; KKC & Associates added as joint auditor 30-Jun-2026. Audit reports not reviewed in this pass.

R6.finding: BRLMs JM Financial and 360 ONE WAM: track record not yet compiled.

rationale.m: EBITDA margin 2.71% / 3.61% / 6.09% FY24-26 (p. 111). FY26 lifted by a rising gold price on a doubled inventory. Bear = FY25 level; Neutral ~3-yr average; Bull holds FY26.
